items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('My name is Monk Rowe') and Tom Porrello as the interviewee. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Tom was interviewed via Zoom on March 6, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Tommy Porrello with me this afternoon. And we’re many miles apart but I’m looking forward to speaking with you. A mutual friend described you as “the quintessential lead trumpet player.”
